import math

# Verify with manual calculation
net_outlays = [59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216, 56838, 76875]

# Calculate mean
n = len(net_outlays)
mean = sum(net_outlays) / n

# Calculate population variance (divide by n)
squared_diffs = [(x - mean) ** 2 for x in net_outlays]
variance = sum(squared_diffs) / n

# Population standard deviation
pstdev = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f'Mean: {mean}')
print(f'Population variance: {variance}')
print(f'Population stdev (manual): {pstdev}')
print(f'Population stdev (rounded): {round(pstdev, 2)}')
